item.title: Netanyahu to Indian Flydubai pilot: A true hero
item.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu published a statement saluting Captain Smit Machchhar, the Flydubai pilot who fought off his terrorist co-pilot and was stabbed in the process.
"My salute to the Indian pilot Captain Smit Machchhar for his extraordinary bravery. Despite being stabbed and seriously injured, he fought back, resisted, opened the cockpit door, and enabled passengers and crew to overpower the attacker - preventing a catastrophic mid-air disaster."
"He saved the lives of 174 people, including Israeli citizens and other nationals. I wish Captain Machchhar a speedy and full recovery. He is a true hero," Netanyahu wrote.

item.title: Following attempted attack: Flydubai service to Israel suspended for six days
item.description: Airline suspends flights for six days after co-pilot attempts to crash plane full of Israelis.

item.title: Knesset Speaker praises Flydubai captain: In a moment of terror, he showed extraordinary courage
item.description:
Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana published a message praising and calling for prayers for the Indian Flydubai pilot who was stabbed by his co-pilot, who attempted to hijack and crash the plane.
"The people of Israel are praying for Captain Smit Machchhar, the brave Indian pilot who fought off his co-pilot’s mid-air attack to save the Israeli passengers aboard flydubai flight FZ1073.
"In a moment of terror, he showed extraordinary courage. Today, our hearts are with him and his family."

item.title: Zvi Yehezkeli: State actor may be behind attempted Flydubai hijacking
item.description: i24NEWS Arab affairs analyst and former airline security guard says attempted hijacking required sophisticated planning, raises possibility Iran or its proxies were behind the incident.

item.title: Following hijacking attempt: FM Sa'ar speaks with Emirati counterpart
item.description:
Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar spoke on Wednesday with the Foreign Minister of the United Arab Emirates, Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan.
During the conversation, which Sa'ar described as "warm," the two expressed their mutual determination to strengthen relations between the countries at all levels and to work together against extremist elements seeking to harm security and undermine stability in the region.
He updated his counterpart on the return of the Israeli passengers. The Emirati Foreign Minister said he was happy to hear that all the Israeli passengers had returned home safely.

item.title: ‘Severe and totally unacceptable’: Herzog condemns Samaria violence
item.description: At the IDF’s Judea and Samaria Division headquarters, Herzog condemned recent violence, backed troops fighting terror, and called for arrests.

item.title: Indian Flydubai pilot who was stabbed no longer in life-threatening condition
item.description:
The Indian pilot who was stabbed during the incident aboard the Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv is no longer in life-threatening condition, although he remains seriously wounded.
The pilot, who was injured during the confrontation with the copilot, managed to open the cockpit door before collapsing, allowing passengers and crew members to intervene and take control of the situation. The plane later landed safely in Saudi Arabia.

item.title: Israeli Minister thanks Saudis: May peace come to us and to all the people of Israel
item.description:
Israeli Minister of Culture and Sports Miki Zohar thanked the Saudis on Wednesday after a plane with nearly 150 Israelis was diverted to the country due to an attempted hijacking.
"On behalf of the people of Israel, I thank the Saudi people for the warm welcome and kindness they showed the Israeli passengers rescued this morning."
"G-d willing, may peace come to us and to all the people of Israel."
He included a video showing a Saudi nurse caring for one of the Israeli passengers in the airport.

item.title: Huckabee on hijacking attempt: 'Israel endures because its people refuse to surrender'
item.description:
US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee remarked on the attempted hijacking of a Flydubai flight from the UAE to Israel and praised the Israelis who subdued the terrorist.
"We thank G-d and breathe a deep sigh of relief that the passengers of Fly Dubai FZ1073 are now safely in Israel. Their heroism in the face of terror averted catastrophe," Huckabee wrote on social media.
"Israel endures because its people refuse to surrender. And tonight we are even more proud to call this extraordinary nation our true partner," he added.

item.title: Magen David Adom on standby at Ben-Gurion Airport
item.description:
MDA teams are on standby at the airport to meet the passengers arriving from Saudi Arabia.
Magen David Adom teams, together with the medical clinic teams at Ben Gurion Airport, are on standby at the airport with mobile intensive care units (MICUs) and ambulances to meet the passengers arriving in Israel from Saudi Arabia.
MDA paramedics will conduct medical assessments of the passengers and, if necessary, provide medical care

item.title: President Herzog on Flydubai incident: 'A great miracle and acts of heroism'
item.description:
President Isaac Herzog visited the Judea and Samaria Division on Wednesday and addressed the attempted terrorist attack aboard the Flydubai flight.
“We went through several very tense hours during a very serious incident that, fortunately, ended with a great miracle and acts of heroism. We embrace and support our brothers and sisters who are on their way back to Israel and thank the heroes. Of course, we will act in every way to thoroughly investigate the incident together with our Emirati partners," Herzog said.
